text:
sophia: Quick weekly from me — a few signals and asks for the next 7 days. TL;DR: EU private beta GA timing, a minor change to our default retention policy, a reliability push on p99 tail, and a cost stability checkpoint. Please skim and act where relevant. :sparkles:
ravi: Thanks. Quick Q: GA date for EU private? Need to lock infra tickets and partner comms.
sophia: Targeting an internal GA on Tue 03/31, public opt-in GA the following week. Keep the private control-plane rollout gated on the new KMS integration and the updated audit logs retention policy (see below).
elaine: Noted — product will freeze new UI changes for private until KMS validation done. We'll surface a short customer-facing FAQ.
noah: Reliability asks: focus on p99 token latency in 2-16k seq workloads. We saw three tail incidents this week — mitigation plan is: increase the worker pool for model variants A/B, enable an interim fallback policy to small-quantized variants, and bump autoscale upper bound by 10% during the rollout window.
sophia: Exact asks: (1) Eng infra — confirm autoscale bump by EOD Mon. (2) ML infra — validate fallback compatibility across <model_family>-v2/quants. (3) Product/CS — draft customer note for opt-in GA with security/retention bullets.
ravi: Will do. I've created a tracking checklist in #eng-releases and assigned owners.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Staging deploy of private-controlplane v3.4 started at 1765130100. Rolling updates to 6 nodes. Monitor: /deploys/1765130100
sophia: Policy update highlight: default retention for logs & convo metadata changes from 90d -> 30d for hosted tiers unless customer requests otherwise. This reduces storage by ~22% projected and helps us meet EU data minimization asks. Enterprise/dedicated customers are unaffected; private retains customer-managed settings.
elaine: We'll add an explicit opt-out checkbox in the billing/setup flow for hosted accounts. Also adding a 1-click export for 30d before deletion.
noah: Ops checklist: update retention config in configs repo, add migration script to trim old logs, and backfill retention metrics to the console. I want a small dashboard for 30/60/90 retention counts.
sophia: Metrics snapshot (this morning): hosted qps +12% w/w, median token latency 70ms, p99 token latency 1.6s (goal 1.2s), infra spend +8% (attributed to burst capacity). Cost target: bring unit cost per 1k tokens down 6% by end of quarter.
ravi: Action items added: batching review, KV cache hit-rate improvements, and quantization trial schedule.
elaine: CS note: prep a short script for AMs highlighting GA opt-in and retention change. Two customers flagged compliance praise for private model gating — good signal.
sophia: One ask to leaders: escalate any customer blockers that would prevent GA by 03/31 — I want a red/amber/green list by EOD Mon. Also, keep the comms tight: no surprises on retention change.
ravi: I'll run the leader sync Monday 9am PT.
noah: I'll post the reliability runbook updates after autoscale change.
sophia: Thanks team. Small wins matter this week — aim for incremental improvements and clear handoffs. :rocket:
